title: Hydrolysis facilities operating as mortuaries or funeral establishments; human remains.
bodyText: Any commercial hydrolysis facility in the State handling human remains shall be subject to the requirements for funeral establishments and mortuaries.
bodyHtml: [§327N-2]  Hydrolysis facilities operating as mortuaries or funeral establishments; human remains.  Any commercial hydrolysis facility in the State handling human remains shall be subject to the requirements for funeral establishments and mortuaries. [L 2022, c 294, pt of §2]
